faq.q: What is the origin of Sri?
faq.a: Sri is associated with Sanskrit. Sri is Sanskrit श्री (śrī), meaning 'prosperity, radiance'. It is used as a female given name in Indonesia and South Asia.
No — the underlying form is Sanskrit, not Arabic.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Sri, sri. Script forms are سري, سری, سْرِي, श्री.

faq.q: Is Sri a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
